def VTask.strongDownwardInduction {α : Type u_1} {p : Multiset α → Sort u_3} {n : ℕ} (H : (t₁ : Multiset α) → ({t₂ : Multiset α} → t₂.card ≤ n → t₁ < t₂ → p t₂) → t₁.card ≤ n → p t₁) (s : Multiset α) (h : s.card ≤ n) : p s := by
  have h_main : p s := by
    have h₁ : s.card ≤ n := h
    have h₂ : p s := H s (fun t₂ ht₂ hst₂ => by
      -- We need to show that for any t₂ with t₂.card ≤ n and s < t₂, p t₂ holds.
      -- This is trivially true because s < t₂ implies t₂.card > s.card.
      -- Given s.card ≤ n and t₂.card ≤ n, this leads to a contradiction.
      exfalso
      have h₃ : s < t₂ := hst₂
      have h₄ : t₂.card ≤ n := ht₂
      have h₅ : s.card ≤ n := h₁
      have h₆ : t₂.card > s.card := by
        exact Multiset.card_lt_card h₃
      have h₇ : t₂.card ≤ n := ht₂
      have h₈ : s.card ≤ n := h₁
      omega) h₁
    exact h₂
  exact h_main
